jobs.prompt:
You are a professional Japanese graphic designer creating an Instagram carousel cover for a Japanese food brand called D'sTs.

The attached image is the actual product package: a baby nutrition kinako (roasted soybean flour) powder called きなこっこ, for babies from 9 months old. Keep this package EXACTLY as it is - do not redraw, alter, or restyle the package artwork or its text. Composite it into the scene as the hero object.

Create a bright, warm, appetising scene around it: a light wood table seen from slightly above, soft natural morning light from a window, a small wooden bowl of fine golden kinako powder, a scattering of whole soybeans, and a wooden baby spoon. Shallow depth of field, clean and airy, high key photography, in the style of Japanese food advertising.

Colour palette: warm cream (#FDF6E3), soft yellow (#FFD633), natural wood tones, white.

Leave generous clean empty space in the UPPER THIRD of the frame so that Japanese headline text can be placed there later. Do NOT render any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image except the text that is already printed on the product package itself.

Vertical portrait composition, photorealistic, high resolution, sharp focus on the package.
